answer.rationale: Release cannot be reverted per compliance, so rollback_release is off the table. Settlement is at peak and writes are heavy — losing the primary region is unacceptable. Read-replica routing and circuit breakers are irrelevant to a write-path p99 problem confined to the primary region, and add_capacity does not address a regional latency spike already 5x target. Regional failover directly attacks the confined primary-region degradation, matches the verified pattern in memory_b2 where failover restored latency fast and traffic shifted cleanly, and keeps customer writes flowing. Verified memory_b1 to confirm rollback precedent is irrelevant here (compliance blocks revert), and memory_b6 to confirm the release itself should not be assumed bad despite staging gating — the patch must stay, so failover not rollback.
